verdict: Source design guidance only; minimal optional test-only wiring feasible
paths: Transfer reviewed cf46 helper/test; bind helper in inner source inventory
design: Add default-off metrics argument to actor. Wrap original sdk.createPXE with original sdk receiver; preserve original promise/result/error. Do not proxy branded PXE/node or change pxe.node.

Immediately after actual PXE construction and before registration/sync or reader construction, wrap public pxe.sync and pxe.getPrivateEvents once on actor-owned instance with unchanged receiver and original methods. Reader captures methods at construction. No queue/raw-store bypass.

Wrap raw next.readPreferenceHead callback on each application rebuild; never call through the exclusive actor wrapper from inside its own readPreferences operation. Do not double-wrap persistent PXE methods.

Enable parent startNodeRpc forwarding observation only for the cold interval; capture method/count/duration around the existing original node call. Label it all forwarded service traffic in that interval, not exclusively this actor. Fault-denied calls require a separate parent counter.

Begin cold interval before fresh constructor, end after exact complete recovered snapshot and source-owned cleanup. Capture partial metrics on failure; pending observers remain gaps, no detached lifecycle. Preserve original empty-store/same-key/head/digest/no-proof/no-send assertions.

Use explicit phase memory samples only; supervisor owns tree RSS and deadline. Leave bytes/discovery/fold unobserved without an existing supported authentic boundary; do not serialize SDK objects, clone response bodies or install global fetch.
requiredChecks: Default-off behavior and branded identity unchanged
Original receiver/args/promise/error retained; no retries or additional network reads
Rebuild binds fresh head callback without double wrapping; close waits actual actor operation before stop
Per-method receiver reconciliation if claimed; cf46 aggregate wireCountsMatch is insufficient for per-method attribution
Actual cold run still proves exact encrypted recovery separately; instrumentation is not capacity qualification
